WITH valid_payments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT payment_intent_id, amount_eur_minor
    FROM v_payment_intent
    WHERE eventually_approved = true AND is_test = false
),
deduped_amounts AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount_eur_minor) AS total
    FROM valid_payments
)
SELECT total
FROM deduped_amounts
question: el importe total de los pagos, calculado paso a paso
sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount_eur_minor) AS total FROM v_payment_intent f JOIN dim_merchant m ON f.merchant_sk = m.merchant_sk WHERE f.eventually_approved = true AND f.is_test = false AND m.risk_tier = 'high' GROUP BY 1
